name: Accordion / Account Settings
description: Account Settings product scenario for the Accordion component.

items.label: Profile and workspace
items.content: Company details, workspace identity, and member preferences.

items.label: Security
items.content: Single sign-on, sessions, and recovery policies.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Sections in order; an item without a unique string `value`, or a group or separator, is dropped with a report.

controls.name: icon
controls.description: Decorative icon (an icon name or a node) at the start of every trigger; `item.icon` overrides it.

controls.name: expanded
controls.description: Values of the open sections (controlled); values without a section are kept for items that arrive later.

controls.name: defaultExpanded
controls.description: Values of the sections open on mount (uncontrolled); later changes are ignored.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Lets several sections stay open; when false, opening one closes the other and only the first open value shows.

controls.name: collapsible
controls.description: Lets the user close the last open section; when false its trigger is `aria-disabled` while open.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables every trigger; panel contents keep their own interactivity.

controls.name: headingLevel
controls.description: The `aria-level` of every trigger's heading, an integer from 1 to 6.
